- FTL no longer hands a symbolic link (e.g. `pihole-FTL.db` or `FTL.log` linked to another disk) to the `pihole` user, and warns about it on every start. Such a target has to be owned by `pihole` already.
This is a minor release rather than v6.7.2: there are enough visible behaviour changes that a patch version would undersell it. It backports the bug fixes that landed on `development` since v6.7.1 and updates the embedded dnsmasq (v2.93+30) and SQLite (v3.53.3).
